title: Use with a device I already have

enter.heading: On a device you already use, go to Workspace, then My devices, and tap Link new device
enter.footer: Scan the QR code it shows, or open or paste its link here. The link says which Hub to use. This device then sees your Machines, Agents and Tasks, and can command them the same way.
enter.noCamera: Veeloe can't use the camera here. Paste the link instead.

name.heading: This device
name.label: Name of this device
name.footer: Your other device shows this name when it asks you to approve, and can change it.

waiting.heading: Approve on your other device
waiting.body: It asks you to approve {{name}}. Keep this open until it's done.
